title: InterpretationContext v2 (p1-ai-language-s10, ADR-0022; verified_actions added in p1-ai-language-s22, ADR-0025)
description: What the engine tells the interpretation service about ONE trainee utterance. Made by src/ProcSense.Core/Speech/InterpretationContextBuilder.cs from the running session; read by server/schemas/interpret.py (ContextIn). Holds no hidden fact, expected answer, score or hint. The engine test InterpretationContextTests and tools/ci/test_interpretation_regression.py both compare their keys with this list.

steps.description: the workflow steps of the running flow stages; empty means nothing is eligible

accepted.description: behaviours already credited from speech in this session

patient_question_pending.description: the consent subsystem's pending patient question

readback_pending.description: a critical result waits for acknowledgement (flag critical.unacknowledged); false where the engine records nothing

verified_actions.description: names of the physical and system actions the engine itself accepted so far (authoritative; context for the evaluator, never a score)
